subject: reasoning
question:
C, D, G, H, I, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table(but not necessarily in the same order).

Only three people sit between I and L when counted from the left of I. Only three people sit between K and H when counted from the right of H. C sits to the immediate right of K. G is an immediate neighbour of H as well as L.

Who sits third to the right of D?
solution:
C, D, G, H, I, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table(but not necessarily in the same order).

 
• Only three people sit between I and L when counted from the left of I.
 
• Only three people sit between K and H when counted from the right of H.
 
• C sits to the immediate right of K.
 
• G is an immediate neighbour of H as well as L

The Final Arrangement is, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dfe3363cd58c6f9c3b5f168e765b965d251a44f3d05c5b1fce3394e1b885fd1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
